title: Step 3–6: the chat and the draft are lost on reload or any click away, with no warning
where: /admin/new, 1440x900, after 4–5 chat turns and edits to the draft
what_happens: The conversation and draft live only in React state. After 5 chat turns and edits to the draft, a reload brought back the empty greeting. The same happens on the '← Sessions' link or the Sessions tab, both right above the chat. No 'leave page?' warning.
who_hurts: An admin who has spent several turns and edits on a draft and steps away (checks the list, reloads a slow page): all of it is gone and they start over.
suggested_fix: Keep messages and draft in sessionStorage (restore on mount, clear after Create), or at least a beforeunload warning while a draft exists.
rule: general: don't lose user work without warning
